source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 19 to 23
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 16, 2026 · 9 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Activision Publishing Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 377 ★★★★★ $69.99 Get it now Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – October 23XBOX Play Anywhere Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point. Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today to gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 ahead of its global launch on October 23. FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Final Fantasy Resonance – October 22XBOX Play Anywhere What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. Shoresy: Legends of the North Treewood Games, New Metric Media ☆☆☆☆☆ 9 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Shoresy: Legends of the North – October 19 Shoresy: Legends of the North is a fast-paced hockey RPG set in the Shoresy universe. Create your skater and join the Sudbury Blueberry Bulldogs on a quest to save the world from the legendary Hockey Godz, or go head-to-head with friends with a roster of fan-favourite characters. Candlemates (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now Candlemates – October 20 Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference! Christmas Across America Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Christmas Across America Collector’s Edition – October 20 Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit! Journey into the heart of winter America to create traditions, find hidden treasures, and experience the magic of the coziest time of year. Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector’s Edition – October 20 Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon! This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon! In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean. This isn’t just a sightseeing tour, it’s a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions. ESG Football 27 Elite Sports Gaming LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 58 ★★★★★ Get it now Elite Sports Gaming Football – October 20 ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character’s attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life. Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector’s Edition – October 20 Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world! Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks. Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together. This Collector’s Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive. Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements. Hail to the Rainbow Sometimes You ☆☆☆☆☆ 29 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Free Trial Hail to the Rainbow – October 20Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hail to the Rainbow is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles. We Were Here Tomorrow Total Mayhem Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 9 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now We Were Here Tomorrow – October 20 On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. When you awaken, you find yourselves inside the mysterious Norček Industries facility with little recollection of what happened. Director Kathleen Bowe needs your help to continue the work of her missing research team before a global crisis unfolds. CyberBot: Zero (Xbox Series) GameDi Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now CyberBot: Zero – October 21 In this thrilling 2D platformer, you play as CyberBot, a brave autonomous unit that must navigate a corrupted mega-facility. source.title: Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13
source.evidenceText: October 27, 2026October 27, 2026 Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13 1 0 14 Like this When empires crumble and all hope seems lost in the blood-soaked mud, what keeps you fighting? Eric Zheng Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing Today, we are proud to unveil the most climactic narrative arc in Where Winds Meet yet: Hutuo, a sprawling new region launching November 13 alongside the game’s first global anniversary update. Marking a major turning point in Where Winds Meet, Hutuo invites you onto an epic, war-torn frontier to experience a story of unwavering conviction, camaraderie, and the true meaning of heroism. Play Video Defining ‘Xia’: From martial arts to universal heroism When we first set out to build Where Winds Meet, our aspiration was to reimagine Wuxia—a genre long confined mostly to classic cinema—as a living, breathing Jianghu for a global audience. Nothing has moved us more than seeing wanderers worldwide find their own resonance within this realm: discovering what ‘Xia’ truly means through personal awakening, sacred promises, and the enduring longing for freedom. We reached an unforgettable milestone this August when the game welcomed over 100 million players worldwide and claimed Best Mobile Game at Gamescom. Being the first to bring an authentic Wuxia open world to the global stage has been a deeply humbling journey, proving that the spirit of this genre speaks to hearts across every border. Yet our vision goes beyond combat choreography and ancient traditions. With Hutuo, we wanted to delve deeper into the spiritual core of ‘Xia’ (Chivalry)—exploring how sacrifice and guardianship reflect a universal heroism that resonates across all cultures. Nowhere is this clearer than in the story we tell at the battle of Zhongdu Bridge. Here, you step into a desperate historical crossroads: northern invaders are surging across the border, frontline defenses are fracturing, and old pacts lie in ruins. With displaced civilians behind you and an unstoppable tide of steel ahead, loyalty and justice pull in opposite directions. A haunting question arises: when the powers above fail, do you fight in blind obedience to a crumbling throne, or rise alongside sworn companions to shield the innocent and guard your homeland? How you answer that call captures what we believe is the truest, most profound essence of ‘Xia’. The Hutuo Battlefield: Uncovering light in the ashes To anchor this theme, we shifted our world design to craft an authentic, mud-and-steel warzone unlike anything seen in the game before. We focused heavily on immersive environmental storytelling and quest design, allowing players to experience the wartime Jianghu from varied perspectives. Whether stepping into the shoes of a conflicted soldier defying brutal orders, listening to a haunting song of displaced survivors among the river reeds, or witnessing nameless folk risk their lives to shelter refugees in the night, each tale captures a distinct facet of the frontier. Even in the darkest corners of history, we wanted these intimate stories to uncover the enduring light of ordinary lives, showcasing the quiet dignity and everyday bravery of people surviving the storm of war. Immersive warfare: PS5 & PS5 Pro enhancements To make every clash across this frontier feel immediate and visceral, we have tailored dedicated technical upgrades for PlayStation players: PS5 Pro & enhanced PSSR: Utilizing enhanced PSSR alongside upgraded ray-traced reflections, Hutuo’s rivers and wetlands look more striking than ever at a stable 60 FPS, bringing fire and falling ash vividly to life across uneven, mud-soaked reflections beneath your feet. Tactile combat & responsiveness: DualSense adaptive triggers and haptics lend physical weight to every drawn war-bow and clashing blade, while reduced frame hitches during effects-heavy battles keep your parries, combos, and dodges razor-sharp. Seamless battlefield scale: Optimized asynchronous asset streaming drastically cuts load times across fast-travel points, dungeons, and cinematic transitions—ensuring your charge into Hutuo’s core warzones remains smooth and uninterrupted. Yuen Woo-ping’s dual spears & a historic first anniversary Experiencing the emotional peak of Where Winds Meet goes hand-in-hand with our biggest celebration yet. Arriving November 13, our first anniversary update delivers the most generous historic rewards since launch, alongside fun and tactical new board game modes like Horse Racing Chess and Jianghu Tactics. The celebration continues on late November with the debut of the Dual Spears Martial Art. Directed and choreographed by legendary action director Yuen Woo-ping (Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon), this dynamic style alternates fluidly between offensive Light Spears and stance-breaking Heavy Spears, building Spear Stance for relentless combo loops. Want an early look at the front lines? Tune in to our First Anniversary Special Broadcast on November 2, where our team will share deeper developer insights and exclusive gameplay reveals for Hutuo.
